title: BHU School Teacher TGT, PGT, PRT, Principal Exam Date 2026
postName: School Teacher TGT / PGT / PRT / Principal
vacancyDetails: Principal: 3 posts, PGT: 9 posts, TGT: 29 posts, PRT: 14 posts
qualification: Post-wise qualification applies. Principal: Master's Degree with at least 50% marks and B.Ed./equivalent teaching degree with prescribed experience. PGT: Master's Degree with at least 50% marks and B.Ed./equivalent degree. TGT: Bachelor's Degree with at least 50% marks and B.Ed./equivalent degree plus CTET. PRT: Senior Secondary with at least 50% marks plus prescribed D.El.Ed./B.El.Ed./Special Education qualification and CTET.
ageLimit: Principal: 35-55 years; PGT: maximum 40 years; TGT: maximum 35 years; PRT: maximum 30 years, relaxable as per rules.
applicationFee: Group A (Principal): Rs. 1000 for UR/EWS/OBC. Group B (PGT/TGT/PRT): Rs. 500 for UR/EWS/OBC. No fee for SC/ST/PwBD and women candidates.
selectionProcess: Computer Based Test (CBT) as per KVS norms, followed by further selection process as applicable. Candidates will be called for CBT without scrutiny of applications.
documentsRequired: Admit card, valid photo ID and required original documents/certificates for later document verification.
howToApply: The application process for this recruitment has already closed. Candidates who applied should visit the BHU Recruitment & Assessment Cell portal for further updates, CBT/admit card information and examination-related notices.
shortDescription: BHU has issued a notice dated 03 June 2026 regarding the Computer Based Test for Principal, PGT, TGT and PRT school teaching posts. The CBT will be held shortly; the exact examination date has not yet been announced.
content:
Banaras Hindu University (BHU) has issued a notice dated 03 June 2026 regarding the Computer Based Test (CBT) for recruitment to Principal, PGT, TGT and PRT school teaching positions.

According to the official notice, the CBT will be held shortly. The exact examination date has not yet been announced by BHU. Candidates should regularly check the official BHU Recruitment & Assessment Cell portal for the exam date and admit card update.

importantDates.examDate: To be announced — BHU has stated that CBT will be held shortly
